title: Clear Kayak Tour
includes: Knowledgeable guide trained in CPR/First Aid
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Free Parking: First come first served
Umbrellas and chairs are available for an extra fee at the beach tent
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Experience Lake Tahoe like never before with a clear kayak adventure. Navigate across crystal-clear waters while taking in breathtaking views of the High Sierra peaks and the lake’s stunning underwater rock formations. This family friendly tour combines adventure, education, and unforgettable scenery, making it perfect for nature enthusiasts of all ages. Delve into Lake Tahoe’s ecology, geology, and fascinating human history as you gently float along the shoreline, guided by our knowledgeable and friendly guide. While on our clear kayak tour you are offered a unique perspective on the lake, allowing you to see up to 70 feet below the surface.

If you are a single traveler, please call the office to see if there is a group to join!
